throughput.notes: The lane-permute unit retires four instructions per cycle. The earlier 8-lane body at --unroll 250/1000 put 8,000 instructions (32 KiB) into L1I and measured 2.6 IPC; a 30-lane body of 6,000 instructions, or even 12 lanes, reaches 0.25 CPI. Four lanes still level off at 3 cycles because the 3-cycle latency cannot be filled by four independent results.

notes: LASX vector instruction measured on LA664.
